# nemau_networks (Data Source)

The project's networks, including the region's external network (`external = true`), useful for allocating a floating IP explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nemau_networks" "all" {}

# The region's external network, to allocate a floating IP from it explicitly.
resource "nemau_floating_ip" "explicit" {
  external_network_id = one([for network in data.nemau_networks.all.networks : network.id if network.external])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Keep only the networks whose name matches this value exactly.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) The matching networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `external` (Boolean) True for the region's external network.
- `id` (String) Network id.
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the platform.
